title: triticum × requienii
intro: Triticum × requienii, commonly known as spelt, is a hybrid of wheat and a species of the wheat grass, belonging to the Poaceae family. This cereal crop is rich in nutrients, offering health benefits such as high fiber content, which aids digestion, and is also a good source of essential minerals like iron and manganese. The therapeutic actions of spelt include its potential to help manage blood sugar levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties, making it beneficial for people with inflammatory conditions like arthritis. The bioactive constituents of spelt include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant activity.
